feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 5 June 2026 7:22am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 05 June 2026 at 7:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Transient ridge of high pressure will decline later today, with an Atlantic weather front reaching the area tonight.


##Wind##

West 4 or 5, backing Southwest later this morning. Further backing South or Southeast in afternoon and evening, increasing occasionally 6 in west of area. Then increasing Southeast 5 to 7 in all waters tonight.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, building moderate or rough tonight.


##Weather##

Fair, only isolated showers, then rain and drizzle soon arriving tonight.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor tonight.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southeast 5 to 7, decreasing 4 or 5 later tomorrow morning and early afternoon. Further decreasing 3 or 4 by evening, veering West or Northwest later in evening, then backing Southwest 4 or 5 overnight into Sunday.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, falling slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Rain and drizzle soon turning light and patchy, clearing later.


##Visibility##

Moderate or poor, improving good.
